technical.summary: Mixed technicals with bullish trend-following signals (SAR, Supertrend, OBV) offset by weak momentum (negative MACD, CMF), price below key moving averages, and lack of confluence—insufficient conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 49 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with no composite congressional conviction, greed-zone caution offsetting neutral AAII sentiment, and absent news data limiting conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 115 crisis regime, rising DXY) creates severe headwinds for MMM; earnings in 49 days adds moderate event risk but is secondary to acute market dysfunction.

debate.key_bull_argument: Trend-following signals (PSAR, Supertrend, OBV bullish) with price near support (73.86) offer potential mean-reversion entry if macro stress temporarily eases.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental vacuum (no insider/institutional conviction, high earnings risk in 49 days), price below all key moving averages, negative momentum (MACD, CMF), and extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve, DXY headwind) create overwhelming structural headwinds that outweigh technical trend signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical trend signals (PSAR, Supertrend, OBV) offer weak support near 73.86, but fundamental vacuum and macro crisis regime eliminate conviction for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 49 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis regime creates severe downside risk that outweighs technical support positioning.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM with 14 existing Industrials positions (26% sector concentration); adding would violate concentration limits and earnings proximity argues for position reduction, not entry.
